intro: In Stormwind, Grimand's Armor takes shape through a test of Furen Longbeard's methods. Grimand Elmore crafts a helm from rare materials, meant to endure punishing blows in battle. For an Alliance warrior, it marks a step toward mastery.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I can barely believe it! Furen's technique was a success, and this armor should withstand tremendous levels of stress.
Here you are, friend. And thank you. I wouldn't have believed Furen's discovery if you hadn't gathered the materials I needed to test it myself.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
